semantic.justification: Native URI scalar/escape owner now serves actual ToIUri and Unambiguous production callers. getUTF32 retains code-unit bounds, surrogate handling, WasEncoded charset branches, NotCanonical octets and invalid UTF8 continuation rollback. Exact 128-entry admission masks and original appendUCS4/legacy UCS4 escape branches are retained. Source generic scheme, filesystem delimiter vote, domain and bracket-reference scanners are ported as prerequisites of the pending native HREF resolver; they do not yet certify whole URL parsing. URI lexical tests and existing shared/filter tests cover this bounded slice. Full INetURLObject parsing, SmartRel2Abs, general decode modes and compiled desktop equivalence remain pending; no parity promotion.
